children.value: > Fact From Story: "This all started when Travis very adorably put me on blast on his podcast, which I thought was metal as hell,” she explained. “We started hanging out right after that. So we actually had a significant amount of time that no one knew, which I’m grateful for, because we got to get to know each other.”
> > Fact From Story: Kelce announced that he went to Swift's highly anticipated concert, but said he did not have the chance to meet the 12-time Grammy winner.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Expressing interest in someone is a common precursor to starting a relationship.

> Fact From Story: Taylor Swift said she connected with Kelce in July, after he confessed on his podcast that he tried and failed to give her a friendship bracelet with his phone number on it during one of her Eras Tour shows.

> > Fact From Story: Kelce revealed that he made a friendship bracelet, a fan tradition at her concerts, with his number on it to give to her, seemingly expressing his interest in Swift. | Fact From Story
> > > > Fact From Story: When his brother asked if it was his jersey number or his phone number, Kelce replied, "you know which one." | Fact From Story
> > > > Commonsense Knowledge: People generally give out their phone number to others they are interested in dating. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Giving someone your number indicates an interest in starting a relationship with them. | Commonsense Knowledge
> Commonsense Knowledge: When someone mentions someone else on a podcast, it can be a way to express interest in them or initiate contact.
